title: Pre-Collect Pack Payment Record and the Monthly Late-Charge Rate — Contingency Placement Agreements
content:
## Rate schedule

The monthly rate of a late charge on a past-due fee invoice of an agreement under the Contingency Placement Agreements depends on how the client has paid its flat-fee pre-collect pack invoice — the invoice for the pack the client bought under the Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs:

| Pre-collect pack invoice | Pack bought | Monthly rate |
|---|---|---|
| paid within the pack's invoice due days after purchase | 12 or more months before the handling date | the tier's late-charge percent per month less half a percentage point (0.50 point) |
| paid within the pack's invoice due days after purchase | less than 12 months before the handling date | the tier's late-charge percent per month less a quarter of a percentage point (0.25 point) |
| any other case | — | the tier's late-charge percent per month |

As a clause: where the client paid its pre-collect pack invoice within the pack's invoice due days after purchase and the pack was bought 12 or more months before the handling date, the rate is the tier's late-charge percent per month less half a percentage point; where it paid that pack invoice within the pack's invoice due days and the pack was bought less than 12 months before the handling date, the rate is the tier's late-charge percent per month less a quarter of a percentage point; otherwise the rate is the tier's late-charge percent per month.

## Notes to the schedule

1. *Records read.* The pack's purchase date, the date its invoice was paid, and the pack's invoice due days — the calendar days after purchase within which the pack invoice must be paid under that pre-collect program — are read from the client's pre-collect program that names this contingency agreement.
2. *Paid within the due days.* The days from the purchase date to the paid date, counted in calendar days with the purchase date not counted and the paid date counted, are no more than the pack's invoice due days.
3. *Age of the pack.* The pack's age is the whole months from its purchase date to the handling date; 12 whole months or more is "12 or more months".
4. *Use of the rate.* The percentage charge is the invoice's unpaid amount multiplied by the monthly rate.
5. *Any other case.* A pack invoice paid after its due days, a pack invoice not paid, and a client with no pre-collect pack all fall in the last row.

## Hypothetical readings

| Tier late-charge percent per month | Pack paid within due days? | Pack age | Monthly rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1.5 | yes | 14 whole months | 1.0 percent |
| 1.5 | yes | 7 whole months | 1.25 percent |
| 1.5 | no, paid 6 days late | 14 whole months | 1.5 percent |
| 1.0 | yes | 12 whole months | 0.5 percent |
| 1.0 | yes | 11 whole months | 0.75 percent |

A pack bought on 2025-03-10 with a 15-day invoice due period and paid on 2025-03-25 was paid on the 15th day, within the due days.
